jxp_a_105_market_stage_1_support_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { which = jxp_tenka_order value = 20 }
			check_variable = { which = jxp_imperial_sanction value = 15 }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { which = jxp_tenka_order value = 20 }
			check_variable = { which = jxp_oceanic_opening value = 15 }
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { which = jxp_imperial_sanction value = 15 }
			check_variable = { which = jxp_oceanic_opening value = 15 }
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_105_can_enter_commercial_council_trigger = {
	tag = JAP
	NOT = { jxp_is_colonial_successor_tag_trigger = yes }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_path_commercial_council }
	OR = {
		jxp_final_state_uncommitted_trigger = yes
		jxp_final_state_open_trigger = yes
	}
	jxp_is_unified_japan_state_trigger = yes
	is_year = 1600
	has_institution = global_trade
	jxp_a_market_stage_at_least_3_trigger = yes
	has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_public_credit_ready
	has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_company_core_ready
	jxp_a_company_has_at_least_2_trigger = yes
	jxp_a_105_market_stage_3_support_trigger = yes
	num_of_owned_provinces_with = {
		value = 3
		OR = {
			province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1
			province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
			province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 3
		}
	}
	monthly_income = 35
	stability = 1
	NOT = { is_bankrupt = yes }
	estate_loyalty = { estate = estate_burghers loyalty = 60 }
	estate_influence = { estate = estate_burghers influence = 60 }
	NOT = { estate_influence = { estate = estate_nobles influence = 70 } }
}

jxp_a_105_founder_legacy_consistent_trigger = {
	calc_true_if = {
		has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_commercial_legacy
		has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_maritime_legacy

		has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_communal_legacy
		has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_founder_frontier_legacy
		amount = 1
	}
}

jxp_a_105_profile_state_consistent_trigger = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { jxp_a_105_any_domestic_profile_trigger = yes }
		AND = {
			calc_true_if = {
				jxp_a_105_profile_uncommitted_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_sakoku_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_open_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_buddhist_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_kirishitan_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_confucian_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_imperial_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_reformed_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_kaikyo_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_ikko_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_wokou_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_toyotomi_trigger = yes
				jxp_a_105_profile_commercial_council_trigger = yes
				amount = 1
			}
			calc_true_if = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_uncommitted
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_sakoku
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_open
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_buddhist
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_kirishitan
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_confucian

				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_kaikyo
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_ikko
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_wokou
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_toyotomi
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_105_model_commercial_council
				amount = 1
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_capstone_complete }
					calc_true_if = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_uncommitted_ready

						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_open_ready

						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_kirishitan_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_confucian_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_imperial_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_reformed_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_kaikyo_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_ikko_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_wokou_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_toyotomi_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_commercial_council_ready
						amount = 0
					}
				}
				AND = {
					has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_capstone_complete
					calc_true_if = {
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_uncommitted_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_sakoku_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_open_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_buddhist_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_kirishitan_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_confucian_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_imperial_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_reformed_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_kaikyo_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_ikko_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_wokou_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_toyotomi_ready
						has_country_flag = jxp_iface_a_domestic_commercial_council_ready
						amount = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
